unresolved_questions: Do segmented controls and the menu list clip at 200% text (UX-13)? Chair to render.
Is the light palette's field border at or above 3:1 against the sunken fill (UX-25)? Chair to measure.

decisions.summary: The design system draws every control and every state; no native picker, list, glyph, thumb, highlight or focus ring shows. Overturns MM-260's acceptance of the native pickers.
A quiet destructive button kind; Cancel is the stronger button in a confirm dialog.
An on switch stays Ember; the theme docs get the exception.
48 dp for everything pressable; chips and compact segments grow or gain a hit area.
A snack with an action has no timeout, from the interaction doc's "nothing is time-limited".
Row icon size, header icon slots, the volume bar grammar and a tier-2 strip primitive land in MM-254 to MM-259, once.
